name: playable-collections
description: Playable Collections — a Civitai App Block (W10 full-page) media player that plays through a collection's images and videos. Mobile-first + desktop-responsive: auto-advancing image/video playback, per-media creator tips, curator tips, on-site collection bookmark (follow), configurable pacing, discovery of public + own collections, and a cross-user 'popular collections' rail backed by App Blocks shared storage.
